experiment_note: Run 4 of codex_think_ec (label codex_think_ec_tools_r2): the tools harness, 15 agents at once. Differences from the v5 label: every tool call runs under a supervisor with a wall-clock deadline that kills the whole process tree including detached children (60 s default, 300 s max, an invalid timeout is rejected); unconfirmed cleanup is an infrastructure error; DeepSeek's native tool-call syntax is recovered into a real call when it leaks as text; the submit client has a bounded 200 s budget inside a 240 s tool deadline, a real exponential backoff, at most 8 HTTP attempts per call and a quiet curl, and labels a rate-limited reply as such. Earlier attempts of this experiment were stopped by the operator and are kept as evidence: codex_think_ec (v4), codex_think_ec_v5 (D39), and codex_think_ec_tools (stopped after 12 minutes: the submit client retried every 2-6 s and made ~1,000 requests the server rejected as rate limited; the server itself had no errors).
